'''Buglins''' are a [[Mobs|Mob]] in the [[Inborn Parasites|Inborn]] Tier. They are overall dark-gray, maggot-like creatures with their ends almost fully black. They seem to have a rough and dry texture with bumps in a ring-like pattern, although its easy to picture it as a wet and slimy being by the sounds they produce.

== ''Spawning'' ==
* Spawns naturally, from [[Evolution Phases#Phase 0|Phase 0]] through [[Evolution Phases#Phase 2|Phase 2]], with a spawnweight of 30, in groups of 2 to 6.
* Spawned by certain [[Assimilated Mobs]]<ref>Assimilated Mobs release different quantities: [[Assimilated Ender Dragon|Ender Dragons]], [[Assimilated Enderman|Endermen]], [[Assimilated Human|Humans]], and [[Assimilated Squid|Squids]] release none. 

 [[Assimilated Horse|Horses,]] [[Assimilated Pig|Pigs]], and [[Assimilated Wolf|Wolves]] release 2.

 [[Assimilated Sheep|Sheep]] and [[Assimilated Villager|Villagers]] release 3.

 [[Assimilated Adventurer|Adventurers]], [[Assimilated Bear|Bears]] and [[Assimilated Cow|Cows]] release 3-4. 

 [[Assimilated Big Spider|Big Spiders]] release 5.</ref> after exploding on death.
* Spawned by [[Tunnel]] blocks and when breaking them.
* Spawned by [[Flying Carrier|Flying Carriers]].
* Spawned by [[Monarch|Monarchs]].
* Spawned in groups of five after eating a [[False Apple]].
* If at least one [[Colony]] exists, spawns when a [[Rupter]] is killed.
* Buglins spawn regardless of [[Emerging Infestation Vector|Vectors]].

== ''Behavior'' ==
Buglins are Transition units as well as Infection Propagators.
* Buglins are unable to attack, fleeing from Aggressive Mobs and Players.
* Buglins will grow into [[Rupter|Rupters]] after a period of 75 seconds.
* Buglins will apply [[Call Of The Hive]] when touched, duration increases the longer contact is made.

===''Weaknesses''===
* Like all Parasites, Buglins are weak to fire. Damage inflicted by fire is quadrupled.

== ''Trivia'' ==
* Buglins are known as '''Lodo''' in the mod files.
* Buglins used to be hostile and attack the player, but this was removed in 1.9.0. Since [[Evolution Phases]] were being introduced, it was decided that Buglins would flee from enemies to preserve their own life, thus increasing their chances of evolving into a [[Rupter]].
* It would be wise '''not''' to eat Buglins.
